meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 把代码仓库里大量相似症状的问题按根因分组，每组建一个主问题并同步设计文档；用统一评论关闭子问题；每组打包一个修复 PR，合并时自动关闭这些子问题。新问题不新开，只归并到已有主问题的评论。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20 个以上开放问题且多为同一根因的不同表现，或者你提出对这些问题做归类、去重、制定计划，又或者想判断新问题是否属于已有计划时，就会触发这套流程。

say.text: 请把这80个问题按根因分组，每组开一个主问题，再关闭所有子问题。
这个新 bug 属于哪个已有计划？若属于就并进去。
say.note: Claude 会匹配现有主问题，追加归类评论并关闭新问题。

say.text: 把 plan-02 的修复打包成 PR，并自动关闭所有关联子问题。

howto.what_en: Claude groups issues by root cause into plan-master issues plus plans/*.md docs, closes children via a standard comment, and ships one PR per cluster that auto-closes them. New bugs get appended to a matching master, not opened.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the repo has 20+ open issues that look like shared defects, when asked to triage, cluster, or dedupe issues (or make a plan), or when routing a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Group these issues by root cause into masters and close the children.
say_en.note: Claude reads all bodies and comments, creates masters, redirects children.

say_en.text: Does this new bug belong to an existing plan? If so, fold it in.
Bundle plan-02's fix into a PR that auto-closes all its child issues.
say_en.note: Claude verifies coverage and generates a PR with Closes #N lines.
